follow-up time: Duration of inpatient stay after cesarean birth
outcome: Post-cesarean delivery opioid consumption (morphine milliequivalents per hour)
Likelihood of being in the highest quartile of MME/h opioid consumption
cohort: 1620 patients who underwent cesarean birth between 2015-2018
finding: While not associated with higher hourly opioid consumption after cesarean birth, maternal obesity and morbid obesity were significantly associated with a higher likelihood of being in the top quartile of opioid consumption.
mod_finding: While not associated with higher hourly opioid consumption after cesarean birth, maternal obesity and morbid obesity were significantly associated with a higher likelihood of being in the top quartile of opioid consumption.
